# `dump --stage lowered --list` reports what a target resolves to: the
# capabilities its platform and language declare, and the passes those enable.
# This checks the CLI answers for every shipping platform, and states the four
# facts about targets the printout is the evidence for.
#
# The caps line reads positively -- it names what the target *can* do, which is
# what its package declares with `#[gen.can]`. It used to name what the target
# could not, back when the lowering held a second inverted record; the passes
# line is unchanged, and is still where "what will run" is read.
#
# AsyncCalls is absent from every Go target, because Go cannot suspend a
# function. AsyncPost is on the two that can get back to the thread they draw
# on, and bubbletea's absence from that list is why the same program it takes
# here is refused as soon as it contains a blocking call -- see
# go_async_no_post.txt.
#
# The pass ORDER is not asserted here. It belongs to internal/lower, which
# states it as pairwise constraints carrying their reasons (orderConstraints);
# a chain of names in this file was a sixth copy of that order with no reason
# attached to any link, and it was silenced by moving a name until it passed.
#
# The caps lines are anchored. They were prefixes before, which is why nothing
# noticed when html grew ReactiveCanvas, Effects and InsertBefore. Anchoring
# them is also what lets the chains go: which passes a target runs is the caps
# line here composed with internal/lower's TestEachCapabilityGatesItsPasses,
# and each half of that is checked where it is decided.

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --list main.sngl
stdout '^caps: Toggle,Lambda,Ref,Unit,Enum,Computed,Reactivity,Declarative,ViewStatements,AsyncSpawn,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,FocusOrder,Canvas$'
stdout '^passes: \w+( → \w+)+$'
stdout ' → Effect → '

# fyne and gtk4 carry ComponentProps and InstanceBodies for the same reason
# html does: a component the build cannot inline is built as a record with its
# own state. Their capabilities are identical, so the gate cannot tell them
# apart and neither can this list -- which is what the cmp says, rather than
# two copies of one chain saying it by coincidence.
#
# SlotChildInstances is the one that does tell them apart, and html is the only
# target with it. It gates on InsertBefore as well, because retaining a slot
# child buys the placement match and nothing else -- a container that only
# appends tears its children down every render, so there is no identity for
# anything to ask about.
sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform fyne --list main.sngl
stdout '^caps: Toggle,Lambda,Ref,Unit,Enum,Computed,ImplicitRecv,ViewStatements,InstanceState,AsyncPost,AsyncSpawn,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,Canvas,ReactiveCanvas$'
! stdout 'SlotChildInstances'
cp stdout fyne.txt

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform gtk4 --list main.sngl
cmp stdout fyne.txt

# html emits HTML and JS; the language emits only the server half of route
# mode. So a restriction that exists because the language lacks a construct is
# not html's -- Ternary and ListLambdas are *held* here for the same reason
# they are held under --lang none, even though Go withholds both. html+go and
# html+none lower identically, which is again the cmp and not a repeated chain.
sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout '^caps: Toggle,Ternary,Lambda,Ref,Unit,Enum,AsyncCalls,Computed,ListLambdas,Declarative,InstanceState,InsertBefore,InlineSlots,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,Canvas,ReactiveCanvas$'
stdout ' → SlotChildInstances → '
cp stdout htmlgo.txt

sngl dump --stage lowered --lang none --platform html --list main.sngl
cmp stdout htmlgo.txt

# android is the one target with no Effect pass: Compose brackets a keyed
# lifetime itself, so it holds Effects and gets the node rather than the
# calls the pass would lower it to. The other four match ' → Effect → ' above,
# so the pattern is one that does match when the pass is there.
sngl dump --stage lowered --lang kotlin --platform android --list main.sngl
stdout '^caps: Toggle,Ternary,Lambda,Ref,Unit,Enum,AsyncReactive,AsyncCalls,Computed,ListLambdas,Reactivity,Declarative,ImplicitRecv,ViewStatements,InstanceState,Effects,StructComponents,StdlibContextParam,Canvas$'
! stdout ' → Effect → '

# Unknown pass name surfaces a non-zero exit.
! sngl dump --stage lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --after NoBogus main.sngl

-- main.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    text(value="hello")
}

window {
    main
}
